svg.aria-label: A coding day drawn as a timeline from 6am to midnight. Agent notifications appear as dots. In the old pattern above, a few dots cluster inside a nine-to-five block. In the new pattern below, dots spread across the whole day: breakfast, the commute, lunch, dinner, the evening and two late dots near midnight, with the late ones circled and labelled still checking.
svg.text: each dot is a notification you looked at
when work can reach you anywhere, it tends to reach you everywhere.
